import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 66;
    static int rows, cols, total_len;
    static char[] str;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] cntA = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cntB = new int[MAXN];
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> part = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> partZero = new ArrayList<>();

    static void precompute_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= total_len; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
        }
    }

    static long compute_diffs(int config, int a_before, int b_before) {
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < cols + 1; ++i) {
            if ((config & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                ++b_before;
                long aux1 = comb[b_before - 1][rows - 1];
                long aux2 = comb[total_len - b_before][rows] - comb[a_before][rows];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                ++a_before;
                long aux1 = comb[a_before - 1][rows - 1];
                long aux2 = comb[total_len - a_before][rows] - comb[b_before][rows];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean is_valid(int config) {
        for (int i = 0; i < cols + 1; ++i) {
            int idx = 2 * rows + cols + i; // 1-indexed in C++
            if (str[idx] == 'A' && ((config >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (str[idx] == 'B' && ((config >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void build_second_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (cols + 1);
        for (int config = 0; config < limit; ++config) {
            int b_cnt = Integer.bitCount(config);
            int a_cnt = cols + 1 - b_cnt;
            long val = compute_diffs(config, rows + cols - a_cnt, rows + cols - b_cnt);
            if (is_valid(config))
                part.get(a_cnt).add(val);
            else
                partZero.get(a_cnt).add(val);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= cols + 1; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(part.get(i));
            Collections.sort(partZero.get(i));
        }
    }

    static long get_coefficient(int config) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i < cols + 1; ++i)
            if (((config >> i) & 1) != (config & 1))
                break;
        for (j = i; j < cols + 1; ++j) {
            int idx = 2 * rows - 1 + j; // 1-indexed
            if (str[idx] == 'A' && ((config >> j) & 1) == 1) return 0;
            if (str[idx] == 'B' && ((config >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
        }
        int setA = rows - 1 + ((config & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int setB = rows - 1 + ((config & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
        int idx = 2 * rows - 2 + i; // 1-indexed
        if (setA < cntA[idx]) return 0;
        if (setB < cntB[idx]) return 0;
        return comb[setA + setB - cntA[idx] - cntB[idx]][setA - cntA[idx]];
    }

    static void update_best(long[] best, long[] candidate) {
        if (candidate[0] < 0) candidate[0] = -candidate[0];
        if (best[0] < candidate[0]) return;
        if (best[0] > candidate[0]) {
            best[0] = candidate[0];
            best[1] = candidate[1];
            return;
        }
        best[1] += candidate[1];
    }

    static long count_occurrences(ArrayList<Long> data, long val) {
        int left = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        if (left < 0) return 0;
        int first = left;
        while (first > 0 && data.get(first-1).equals(val)) first--;
        int last = left;
        while (last < data.size()-1 && data.get(last+1).equals(val)) last++;
        return last - first + 1;
    }

    static long compute_first_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (cols + 1);
        long[] best = new long[]{1L << 60, 0};
        for (int config = 0; config < limit; ++config) {
            int b_cnt = Integer.bitCount(config);
            int a_cnt = cols + 1 - b_cnt;
            long act = compute_diffs(config, rows - 1, rows - 1);
            long coef = get_coefficient(config);
            int idx = cols + 1 - a_cnt;
            ArrayList<Long> list = part.get(idx);
            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(list, -act);
            if (pos >= 0) {
                long val = list.get(pos);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long cnt = count_occurrences(list, val);
                    update_best(best, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                }
            } else {
                int insert = -pos - 1;
                if (insert < list.size()) {
                    long val = list.get(insert);
                    if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                        long cnt = count_occurrences(list, val);
                        update_best(best, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                    }
                }
                if (insert > 0) {
                    long val = list.get(insert - 1);
                    if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                        long cnt = count_occurrences(list, val);
                        update_best(best, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                    }
                }
            }
            // partZero with coef=0
            coef = 0;
            list = partZero.get(idx);
            pos = Collections.binarySearch(list, -act);
            if (pos >= 0) {
                long val = list.get(pos);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long cnt = count_occurrences(list, val);
                    update_best(best, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                }
            } else {
                int insert = -pos - 1;
                if (insert < list.size()) {
                    long val = list.get(insert);
                    if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                        long cnt = count_occurrences(list, val);
                        update_best(best, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                    }
                }
                if (insert > 0) {
                    long val = list.get(insert - 1);
                    if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                        long cnt = count_occurrences(list, val);
                        update_best(best, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return best[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        rows = sc.nextInt();
        cols = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        total_len = 2 * (rows + cols);
        str = new char[total_len + 2]; // 1-indexed, extra for safety
        for (int i = 1; i <= total_len; ++i) {
            str[i] = s.charAt(i-1);
        }
        precompute_comb();
        for (int idx = 1; idx <= total_len; ++idx) {
            cntA[idx] = cntA[idx-1] + (str[idx] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[idx] = cntB[idx-1] + (str[idx] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        // Initialize part and partZero
        for (int i = 0; i <= cols + 1; ++i) {
            part.add(new ArrayList<>());
            partZero.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        build_second_part();
        long solution = compute_first_part();
        System.out.println(solution);
        sc.close();
    }
}
